reason: The first order is all cash on delivery, so I risk nothing, and I would try one small order of a few light things in one parcel. If it actually arrives and looks like the photo, then maybe I trust them.
objection: After the first order they want 30% before I see anything, and that is exactly how my cousin lost her money. Also for cheap small things, 13,000 a kilo plus the fee and delivery can cost almost as much as the item itself.
would_change_my_mind: If every order, not only the first, stayed full cash on delivery, I would buy from them regularly.
